Name: Abrah's Swiss Roll Recipes

[size=4][b][u][i]Abrah's Swiss Roll recipes[/i][/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Ingredients: 1 strawberry, 1 milk, 1 wheat flour[/size]

[size=4]energy: 175[/size]
[size=4]health: 78[/size]

[size=4]2.[color=#0000ff]Blueberry Swiss Rolls:[/color][/size]
[size=4]Ingredients: 1 blueberry, 1 milk, 1 wheat flour[/size]
[size=4]sell price: 320[/size]
[size=4]Energy: 175[/size]
[size=4]health: 78[/size]

[size=4]3.[color=#7f6000]Dulce de leche Swiss Rolls:[/color][/size]
[size=4]ingredients: 1 sugar, 1 milk, 1 wheat flour[/size]
[size=4]sell price: 360[/size]
[size=4]energy: 195[/size]
[size=4]health:87[/size]

[size=4]Requirements:[/size]
[size=4]Content Patcher[/size]
[size=4]SMAPI[/size] 
[heading]Enjoy ♡[/heading]
